The '''Wesessa Sea''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It bordered [[Betu/Legends|Betu]] and contained the [[An'yettu Islands/Legends|An'yettu Islands]] as well as the isle of [[Wesessa]]. The ceremonial blaster of Rodia's [[first Grand Protector]] was said to be buried deep below the sea floor.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The First Protector}}</ref>
